faq.q: What is the origin of Talal?
faq.a: Talal is associated with Arabic. Talal is Arabic طَلَال (Ṭalāl), denoting dew or fine rain.
Yes — the underlying form طَلَال is Arabic.
Talal can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Talal should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Ṭalāl is not a Quranic personal name.
